facts.statement: The July 2026 Project Gigabit contract publication was updated on 20 July 2026.
BDUK publishes monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress data.
Contracted-premises data covers the initial contract scope.
Deferred-scope premises may be absent from the contracted-premises figures.
CO denotes a Type C Call Off contract.
The contract table is not directly comparable with BDUK official-statistics releases.
The management table tracks contracted premises where suppliers delivered a gigabit-capable connection.
BDUK official statistics instead report premises connected as a result of BDUK subsidy.
The July table is a snapshot of BDUK data held on 16 July 2026.
BDUK records can have a variable lag between contract signature or delivery and ingestion.
The July figures should not be used to assess contractual milestone achievement.
BDUK directs users to its UPRN-level release guide and technical note for processing details.
The July data is rounded to the nearest 10.
July table totals may not sum because of rounding.
Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes recorded 5,890 contracted and 4,820 built premises.
Bucks, Herts and East of Berks recorded 6,090 contracted and 4,050 built premises.
CO1 recorded 60,180 contracted and 17,170 built premises.
CO2 recorded 41,140 contracted and 10,600 built premises.
CO3 recorded 65,120 contracted and 2,570 built premises.
CO4 recorded 37,110 contracted and 3,840 built premises.
CO5 recorded 35,300 contracted and 2,260 built premises.
CO6 recorded 77,640 contracted and 5,680 built premises.
CO7 Worcestershire recorded 22,980 contracted and 1,010 built premises.
CO8 Cheshire recorded 18,460 contracted and zero built premises.
